candidate_definitions.frequency-filtered bilinear: normalized Gaussian-window quadrature of cos(omega_n*t)*A2(t); A2 is SYKED's fixed norm-one random even Hermitian bilinear

conventions.heat_kernel: exp[-delta*(H-E0)] on both sides of each insertion
conventions.relative_defect: Frobenius norm of the projected 3x3 Ward-matrix residual divided by max(target-matrix norm, candidate-matrix norm)
conventions.state_family: TFD plus two normalized one-bilocal insertion vectors
conventions.two_dot_action: H0*C=H*C+C*H; right coefficient multipliers reverse products
